Hey Product Hunt — Rohit here, maker of Calerto.

I built Calerto because ordinary calendar notifications are surprisingly easy to miss when you are deep in work, in Focus mode, or moving between apps.

Calerto for Mac gives important meetings a much harder-to-miss moment:

• Connect Apple Calendar and Google Calendar

• Choose which calendars appear

• Set alerts 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60 minutes — or a custom time — before a meeting

• Get a full-screen alert, including during Do Not Disturb / Focus

• Join the meeting directly from the alert

• Keep your schedule on your device

The goal is intentionally simple: help you stay focused without accidentally missing the meeting that matters.

results.title: MeetIsland: The Dynamic Island that gets you to meetings on time | Product Hunt
results.content:
JoWatanabe

Maker

📌

Hi Product Hunt! 👋 I kept joining meetings 2 minutes late. Menu bar apps require glancing — and deep in work, I don't glance. Full-screen alerts felt like being yelled at. So I built MeetIsland: your next meeting lives quietly around the MacBook notch, and right before start it expands into a Dynamic Island-style card with a live countdown and one-click Join (Meet/Zoom). A few choices I care about: zero setup (it reads calendars macOS already syncs — no OAuth, no accounts), your calendar never leaves your Mac, it works on Macs without a notch via a virtual island, and it's a one-time $6.99 purchase — tools should be buyable, not rentable. Native Swift, the whole download is ~600 KB. I'd love your feedback — especially: should Teams link detection come next? 🙏 [...] Subscribe

results.title: Chime - Remember Everything: One alert system for all your time-sensitive items | Product Hunt
results.content:
The Alert You Can't Ignore

🖥️ Full-screen takeover - Not a banner. Not a popup. Your ENTIRE screen becomes the alert (see demo video)

⏰ Smart timing - Default 5 minutes before video calls, 3 minutes before regular events (This is fully customizable up to 1 minute before the calls, by the way.)

🎵 Non-startling and ADHD-friendly sounds - 5 soothing alert sounds that rotate automatically to prevent habituation (when your brain starts ignoring the same notification)

🔒 Privacy-first - Everything runs locally on your Mac. No calendar data, reminders, or tasks ever leave your device.

Who This Is For

While I built this for my own forgetful brain, it turns out a lot of people struggle with time-blindness sometimes:

Developers in deep focus mode

Designers in creative flow [...] Developers in deep focus mode

Designers in creative flow

Remote workers juggling back-to-back Zoom calls

Students with assignments and virtual classes

Anyone who's ever joined a meeting late and blamed "technical difficulties" 😅

Key Features of Chime

Auto-extracts meeting links from 30+ platforms (Zoom, Teams, Meet, Webex, etc.). This helps you join meetings directly from Chime.

Multi-monitor support for the full-screen alerts (all displays, primary only, external only, or follow your mouse)

Hourly recurring reminders (perfect for "drink water" or "take a break" or even manifestations!)

Statistics tracking (meetings joined vs. missed, reminder completion rate)

100% local. No cloud sync, no personal data collection

Native macOS app (13.0+)

Pricing & Trial [...] Those tiny notification banners? They'd appear for 5 seconds while I was deep in design/code and vanish into the void. When I'm in DND mode or even full screen mode of some apps, this gets worse. The problem wasn't that I was disorganized...polite notifications just don't work for my brain.

If you've ever thought "wait, that was TODAY?!", you're not alone!

What Makes Chime Different

Chime is a unified time-based productivity assistant that takes over your entire screen with impossible-to-miss alerts for:

✅ Calendar meetings (iCloud, Google, Outlook, Exchange)  
✅ Apple Reminders (time-based reminders with due times)  
✅ Todoist tasks (tasks with deadlines. This is an optional integration)
